hero.title: Sound Design Work
hero.subtitle: Combat redesigns, weapon synthesis, spell FX, and creature vocals. All original recordings and processing in Reaper, Logic Pro, and Studio One.

video1.title: God of War: Combat Scene Redesign
video1.description: Replaced all combat audio with original field recordings and foley. Axe impacts, shield blocks, enemy screams, and environmental destruction -- recorded, processed, and mixed in Reaper.

video2.title: Baldur's Gate: Spell Effects Remake
video2.description: Remade spell sound effects from Baldur's Gate using layered synths and processed recordings. Fire, ice, and arcane spells each built from scratch.

video3.title: Weapon Sound Design: Realistic vs. Sci-Fi
video3.description: Two weapons, two worlds: a P2000 pistol with realistic recordings and foley vs. a futuristic energy weapon built from synths and experimental processing.

video4.title: Fracture Horizon: Linear Sound Design
video4.description: My first-ever sound design project. Replaced all audio for a sci-fi scene -- spaceship hums, alarm systems, mechanical doors. Basic but taught me the fundamentals of syncing sound to picture.
